src/course/player.js.scope: Saved speed/voice preferences, Media Session metadata and lock-screen/headset actions, system-initiated pause reflected in the dock, portrait caption companion text.

src/course/index.html.scope: Portrait-only companion section (step, current clause, landscape hint).

src/course/course.css.scope: Portrait phone layout (natural-height 16:9 stage, large caption, wrapped dock with core controls) and landscape phone layout (one-line header, compact dock, stage fits screen).

README.md.scope: Documents saved preferences, media controls and phone layouts.

.github/workflows/pages.yml.scope: Pages workflow moves to Node 24 action majors: setup-node v6, configure-pages v6, upload-pages-artifact v5 (bundles upload-artifact v7). Evidence workflows stay byte-identical because their recorded runs are bound to the workflow bytes.

review_scope.feature: Phone layouts, saved playback preferences, Media Session controls and system-pause handling for the animated courses
review_scope.verification: Chrome desktop and Playwright WebKit with iPhone 13 portrait/landscape emulation: playback, OS-style pause, preference persistence across reload, Media Session metadata/state, manual seek, no horizontal overflow and all core dock controls inside the viewport. Overview chapter cut windows measured as digital silence.
review_scope.not_verified: Physical iPhone/Android devices, real lock-screen UI and AirPods controls.
